claim: In recon_dest_query.go, CountRows formats pkColumn using quoteIdent(pkColumn), which wraps the argument in double quotes as a SQL identifier before falling back to a second read-only transaction on error.
In recon_dest_agent.go, readOnlyDB starts a transaction with Begin() and then executes a separate SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY command.
In recon_smoke.go, scanExact calls CountRowsBeforeCutoff with pkColumn _gpay_id and then separately calls CountDeletedRowsBeforeCutoff.

In recon_window_index_probe.go, CountRowsBeforeCutoff checks da.IsMongo() when cutoffHi is non-zero, and then proceeds directly to observability.ChildSpan pg.count_rows without checking da.IsNonPostgresSQL().
In recon_dest_safety.go, quoteIdent wraps the string in double quotes and doubles any embedded double quotes.
In recon_dest_safety.go, quoteIdent strips all quotes and converts the string to an integer.
In recon_dest_agent.go, readOnlyDB closes the database connection pool and panics.
